title: Posterior compartment of leg
summary: The posterior compartment of the leg is one of the fascial compartments of the leg and is divided further into deep and superficial parts:
-Triceps surae muscle -Gastrocnemius muscle -Soleus muscle -Calcaneal tendon -Plantaris muscle
-Popliteus muscle -Tibialis posterior muscle -Flexor digitorum longus -Flexor hallucis longus

sections.heading: Innervation
paragraphs: The posterior compartment of the leg is supplied by the tibial nerve.
